test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

Rohan is quite popular ______ his classmates.
solution: The correct answer is '**among**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate preposition for the given blank is '**among**'. • **Among** is used when talking about people or things that are not distinct and are viewed as a group. • In the given context that group is '**classmates**'. • *Example: There wasn't much unity **among** the council members.* **Correct Sentence:__** *Rohan is quite popular **among** his classmates.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिए गए रिक्त स्थान के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त पूर्वसर्ग '**among**' है। • **Among** का उपयोग उन लोगों या चीजों के बारे में बात करते समय किया जाता है जो अलग नहीं हैं और जिन्हें एक समूह के रूप में देखा जाता है। • दिए गए संदर्भ में वह समूह '**classmates**' है। • *Example: There wasn't much unity among the council members.* 3d:Tb68, The correct answer is '**Cowardly**'.
